evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.note: The scenario's own input tuple (roster, levels, items, ability ranks) is defined outside data/ and was NOT available to this oracle. The computation below therefore reconstructs the multiplier chain from the two cached amplifier figures and the reported leaf values, rather than re-deriving the base damage from champion stats.

sources_quoted.text: Enemy champions within {{tt|700 units|center to edge}} of you become cursed, causing them to receive {{as|12% increased magic damage|magic damage}} from all sources.
sources_quoted.reading: amp = x1.12, gated on damage TYPE = magic and on the damaged unit being an ENEMY CHAMPION of the Abyssal Mask holder; 'from all sources' widens the ATTACKER set (allies included), it does not widen the damage-type set.

sources_quoted.text: {{tip|Immobilize|Immobilizing}} an enemy champion marks them as ''Vulnerable'' for 4 seconds, increasing the damage they take from all sources by 7%. Subsequent immobilizes against a target extend the duration of the effect.
sources_quoted.reading: amp = x1.07, NOT gated on damage type (all of physical/magic/true).

sources_quoted.text: Independent damage value modifiers distinct from resistances: percentage damage amplification, percentage damage reduction, and flat damage reduction; percent modifiers stack multiplicatively with each other and with resistance-based reduction.
sources_quoted.reading: the two amps compose multiplicatively, not additively.

sources_quoted.text: Sources combine by multiplying the underlying factors (10% + 10% damage reduction = 0.9 x 0.9 = 19% total reduction); applies to percent penetration, cripples, slow resist and to damage amplifiers vs damage reductions.
Damage type not reduced by resistances or almost all damage-reduction effects; ... is affected by most damage amplifiers
sources_quoted.reading: a true-damage row still takes the Mandate 7%, and still must not take the magic-only 12%.

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 1.2 / audit table row 'Resistance mitigation'
sources_quoted.text: the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is *linear in raw damage* for a fixed resistance
sources_quoted.reading: a per-source percentage amplifier is a scalar factor on the row total, so the leaf value scales exactly by the amp product - the ratio test below is exact, not approximate.

sources_quoted.source: data/items.json full sweep for percent damage-taken amplifiers
sources_quoted.text: Abyssal Mask 'Unmake' (12% magic) is the ONLY cached item effect granting a 12% increase to damage received; no rune in data/runes.json grants a 12% damage-taken amp.
sources_quoted.reading: the 1.12 factor in the leaf delta is uniquely attributable to Unmake.

step_1_ratio_test.conclusion: the delta is exactly one multiplicative factor of 1.12 (1/1.12 = 0.8928571...; 209.1 x 1.12 = 234.192 -> 234.2; 234.2 / 1.12 = 209.107 -> 209.1). Both golden values are the 1-decimal rounding of the same underlying pair.

independent_computation.step_2_identify_the_factor: 1.12 is Abyssal Mask 'Unmake'. It is the only 12% damage-received amplifier in the cached item and rune data. So the change is precisely: this one damage-source row stopped receiving the Abyssal Curse magic amplifier.

step_3_recover_the_amp_chain.conclusion: The old value is reproduced exactly by MULTIPLICATIVE composition of the two cached amps (1.07 x 1.12 = 1.1984) on a base of 195.42, and is NOT reproduced by additive composition (232.55 != 234.2). So the engine's composition rule was already correct on both sides of the change; the only thing that moved is the damage-type gate on the magic-only amp. The new value 209.1 = base x 1.07 keeps the all-damage-type Mandate amp and drops the magic-only Abyssal amp - the exact signature of a row whose damage type is NOT magic.

independent_computation.step_4_rule_application: Unmake is gated on magic damage ('12% increased magic damage'). Command is not gated on damage type ('the damage they take from all sources by 7%'). A physical or true damage row on a Vulnerable + cursed enemy must therefore total base x 1.07, not base x 1.07 x 1.12. 195.4206 x 1.07 = 209.107 -> 209.1.

counter_hypothesis_considered.hypothesis: breakdown[1] is an ALLY of the Abyssal Mask holder dealing MAGIC damage to the cursed enemy, and the change wrongly narrowed 'from all sources' to holder-only - in which case 234.2 (both amps) would be correct.
why_rejected: Under that reading the surviving factor set would have to be {1.07} on a magic row, i.e. the engine would keep the ally-sourced Mandate amp while dropping the ally-sourced Abyssal amp. Both effects are ally-sourced team amps with identical 'from all sources' wording, so no coherent attacker-scope rule drops one and keeps the other; a damage-TYPE rule drops exactly one and keeps the other, which is what the numbers show.

The alternative decomposition (new = un-amped base 209.1, old = 209.1 x 1.12) would mean the new value carries NEITHER amp - i.e. Imperial Mandate's Vulnerable +7% is not applied at all in a scenario named for it. That would make the new value wrong too, but it is the less parsimonious reading: it requires the leaf's target to be cursed-but-not-Vulnerable while the scenario name pins both effects live.

Removing a magic-only amplifier from a non-magic row is a per-row (damage-type) correction, which matches the observed granularity: a single sources[] entry inside one breakdown changed rather than every magic row in the roster.

residual_uncertainty: This oracle could not read the scenario definition (it lives outside data/), so the damage type of breakdown[1]/sources[3] was inferred from the multiplier decomposition rather than observed directly. The verdict is therefore 'new_value_correct' on the strength of: (a) the delta being exactly Unmake's cached 12%, (b) the surviving factor matching Mandate's cached all-type 7% on a consistent base, and (c) Unmake's cached wiki text restricting the amp to magic damage. If the scenario definition shows sources[3] is a MAGIC damage row dealt to the cursed enemy, this verdict inverts to old_value_correct.
